manual_playtest_checklist: Confirm no obvious required/interactable markers are outside the playable map.
Confirm red HUD/debug text is still readable.
Press key 3 / Bentley action and confirm no crash.
Go to code gate and confirm at least three code options appear.
Confirm the UI does not tell you which option is correct.
Choose/type wrong code and confirm wrong-code feedback.
Go to bag room, find visible delivery bag, and press E.
Open pause menu Objectives submenu and confirm objective appears or updates.
Press E on Louis before completing requirements and confirm locked/missing message.
Complete required bag/gate objectives and press E on Louis again.
Walk near CAM marker areas and confirm active camera cones sweep/search.
Walk near GUARD marker areas and confirm guards are present and patrol.
Confirm counts still do not subtract incorrectly.
Confirm repeated interactions do not crash.
Confirm purple marker labels remain readable and do not block movement.
